answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Consistency Rule: each identity’s action vector is scored per epoch, and the score must remain within a tolerance band across consecutive epochs, checked against a persistent trellis of prior epoch signatures. Identities whose behaviour diverges sharply (a ripple in the consistency profile) are flagged and throttled. Fresh sybil identities must spend several epochs replicating a stable behaviour pattern, and each replica pays continuous compute and latency to imitate it. A juniper threshold sets the minimum consistency score for full participation,
